title: englerastrum tetragonum
intro: Englerastrum tetragonum, commonly known as the "Bathori" or "Tetragonum", is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including the reduction of fever, relief from respiratory problems, and the alleviation of pain. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
